title: Chapter 816
text:
Floating Dragon Island hovered near Blue Star like a gigantic satellite. When the people on the surface looked up, they would be able to see a gigantic golden island in the sky. Countless people had a shocked expression on their faces. They stopped in their tracks and looked up on the streets, discussing among themselves.

"What is that? It looks a little familiar … "An old man pressed on his glasses with trembling hands and activated the binoculars function.

"Mom! I've seen it in textbooks before. That's the legendary Floating Dragon Island that floats in the universe, the palace of the Dragon Emperor! "A child said with an agitated tone, pulling the hand of an auntie beside him and pointing at the sky.

"Oh! So, it's Ames. "The auntie was enlightened.

After Blue Star broke through the blockade of Godora's quantum network and connected to the galaxy, the people's knowledge level had increased tremendously in the past decade or so. They now had some understanding of the universe's environment and the famous people in the Shattered Star Ring. Because of Han Xiao, the survivors of Blue Star's mutation era were very familiar with Ames.

Not only did the people know that she was once Black Star's boss, but they also remembered that the turning point of their connection to the galaxy came from the protection of Floating Dragon Island. Ames had a special place in the hearts of the people of Blue Star.

Seeing Floating Dragon Island appear near Blue Star, many people could not help but feel surprised and confused. They called their friends and shared the news, which attracted a lot of attention.

The people of the various financial groups who stayed in Blue Star also noticed Floating Dragon Island and were shocked. They hurriedly asked the Blue Star government, desperately wanting to know the reason.

At the same time, Ames and the others arrived at the dock in a small spaceship and met with Bennett.

"Your Excellency Dragon Emperor, Blue Star welcomes your arrival." Bennett bowed, his tone solemn and full of respect.

He was very familiar with Han Xiao, and they had been friends for over twenty years. This was why his attitude was so casual. However, he wasn't that familiar with Ames. Bennett followed the common etiquette in the interstellar space. Even though he knew that Han Xiao had a close relationship with Ames, he didn't dare to overstep his boundaries.

Ames waved her hand, indicating that there was no need to be so polite. She chuckled and said, "Black Star has told me about my request, and Jenny has also contacted you. I came to see you this time mainly to go through the motions."

Bennett nodded. He had received a notification from Han Xiao some time ago that Floating Dragon was going to be stationed in Blue Star. At that time, he had been shocked, but he had been overjoyed. He had realized that this was a rare opportunity, so he had hurriedly mobilized his manpower to cooperate with Floating Dragon.

According to Ames' plan, this matter would be kept a secret before it was confirmed. She would only announce it after everything was done. The goal was to create a surprise and cause a commotion in the Star Field. This would be beneficial for Floating Dragon to break the old impression and let more galactic residents have a new understanding of Floating Dragon.

For this reason, Bennett had not announced it to the people of Blue Star in advance and only planned to announce it now.

"I will hold a press conference in the name of Blue Star and announce that Floating Dragon will be building a base here."

"How long will it take?"

"Only a few hours. Some galactic media outlets have people here, so it won't take too long to invite them. What do you think?"

Ames nodded and agreed. Floating Dragon would be staying here for a long time. She was here to attend the press conference and let others confirm the authenticity of this matter.

"By the way, I just met a group of extremists from the Star Pupil Protoss race. They were wandering around Blue Star, and there were dangerous psionic bombs in their cabins. They seemed to want to attack Blue Star. I killed them and seized their spaceship. There are videos on it, so I'll leave them to you guys. It has nothing to do with me."

Bennett was stunned for a moment.

Star Pupil Protoss race … This is because of Black Star, right? Their hatred for Black Star has been transferred to Blue Star.

"I will inform His Excellency Black Star."

Bennett's tone was serious. Since it involved the race of another Beyond Grade A, it was not easy for him, the leader of a civilization that had yet to reach the Star System level, so he planned to ask for Han Xiao's opinion.

Although this incident was stopped in time, it could be said that Black Star had implicated Blue Star, causing Blue Star to suffer an unexpected calamity. Blue Star had suffered a similar calamity in the past. For example, Stephanie, under Thousand Shadows, had seen Blue Star as a weakness in order to deal with Black Star.

However, Bennett did not have any complaints. He knew very well that since he was enjoying the benefits brought by Black Star, he would definitely be noticed by Black Star's enemies. There was no such thing as a sure win and no loss.

A high-level battle was like a stormy sea, and Blue Star was just a small boat in the middle of the ocean. If they were not careful, they would be affected, and the boat would be destroyed. However, if they were to give up the opportunity to rise up their civilization and turn away from their protector just because they were afraid of Black Star's enemies, this would be the behavior of a younger brother. If the Six Nations had been in power in the past, they might have considered such a choice, but Bennett would not have been swayed.

Now that Floating Dragon had arrived, the safety index of Blue Star would be raised by a few levels, and no one would think of Blue Star as a weakness of Black Star anymore. This hidden danger was solved instantly.

Bennett naturally did not know the motive of Ames coming to Blue Star, so the way he saw it, Han Xiao definitely had something to do with this matter. Otherwise, Ames would not have come. He could not help but admire Han Xiao's foresight.

…

Three hours later …

Many galactic media outlets gathered together, and the reporters were waiting for the arrival of the spokesperson in the government building.

"The moment Floating Dragon appeared, the Blue Star government rushed to hold a press conference. It should be related to Floating Dragon."

"For them to invite us so urgently, there might be something big to announce."

"It can't be. Floating Dragon drifts everywhere and never stays in one place for too long. It's not surprising that it came to Blue Star by chance."

While the reporters were whispering to each other, they suddenly heard many government workers carrying equipment in and setting up broadcast equipment in the venue.

Seeing this, the reporters were shocked.

Was this going to be broadcasted to the entire world? Usually, it would only be used for big events.

Just as the reporters were guessing, the door of the venue opened with a bang. All the reporters turned around, and their eyes widened with shock.

The person who came in was not the Blue Star government spokesperson they were familiar with but the head of the government, Bennett. Beside him was a famous person who shocked all the reporters. It was the Dragon Emperor Ames.

Hua!

All the reporters were shocked. This was the Blue Star government's press conference, and Ames was actually here?

Dumbfounded, they stared at Bennett and Ames as they walked onto the stage.

"There's something I want to announce to the entire world and even the entire Star Field." Bennett cleared his throat, looked around, and said with a solemn tone, "From today onward, Floating Dragon will be staying in Blue Star's atmosphere for a long time. On behalf of the Aquamarine Federation, I welcome our new neighbor."

Without waiting for the reporters to react, Ames opened her mouth.

"Floating Dragon has drifted for too long, and I've decided to stop. From today onward, this will be Floating Dragon's headquarters."

The entire venue was so silent that one could hear a pin drop.

Boom!

The next moment, an uproar broke out. Everyone's expression changed drastically!

All the reporters were trembling with excitement.

They had encountered big news!

…

The news of Floating Dragon building a headquarters in Blue Star spread like wildfire and swept across the Shattered Star Ring like a hurricane. All the organizations that knew about it were shocked.

Floating Dragon had stopped drifting. In the eyes of the galactic residents, this was a sign that Ames was no longer lazy and was going to officially start managing her organization. However, this was not the most shocking thing. What shocked the entire Star Field the most was that Floating Dragon's headquarters was actually located on Black Star's mother planet!

All the organizations knew that the Black Star Corps' most obvious headquarters was usually located on Planet Golden Gate. However, after Han Xiao obtained a seat in the Shattered Star Ring Civilization Conference with the help of the Blue Star Civilization, many people thought that Blue Star had become Black Star's second headquarters, not to mention that this was his mother planet.

So, what was Floating Dragon trying to do? Building their own headquarters in Black Star's headquarters?

Was it just the alliance between the two Beyond Grade A organizations that had become closer?

No, it was definitely not just that!

Back when Heber challenged them to a battle, Black Star had been on the same side as Dragon Emperor. The fact that the Black Star Corps and Floating Dragon were allies was something that everyone in the Shattered Star Ring knew. However, while they were allies, the territories of the two organizations were clearly separated. The Black Star Corps had many branches, while Floating Dragon had no fixed territory.

However, Floating Dragon had actually chosen to stay in Blue Star. This was not a random branch but their own headquarters!

For a galactic organization like this, if there was no special reason, even if they were allies, they would not allow their headquarters to be in the same place. At most, they would set up a branch in their ally's territory. The Dragon Emperor had obviously not moved to Black Star's mother planet to fight for territory. According to the news, Floating Dragon would not move so easily.

This represented absolute trust!

They believed that they would not betray each other. Otherwise, they would not leave their backs to their allies. This kind of trust was extremely rare between galactic organizations.

The relationship between the two organizations was too close, and it had already surpassed the level of ordinary allies. It was so close that the various organizations could not help but think of another possibility. Could it be that these two organizations … had a chance to merge?

Normally, a Beyond Grade A would not easily become the subordinate of another Beyond Grade A, so Beyond Grade A organizations were basically incompatible with each other. However, other than submission, cooperation, and alliance, there was another kind of relationship that was very common among ordinary creatures but rarely appeared between Beyond Grade As …

The various organizations were not imagining things. According to the past deeds of Black Star and the Dragon Emperor, this was not without reason. Furthermore, not long ago, when Black Star went to meet the dynasty's ruler, he had shockingly brought along Ames. This had already surpassed the position of a neutral organization!

This was a dangerous sign.

If the two organizations really went beyond alliance and officially merged, this would mean that the Shattered Star Ring would have a suppressive unofficial organization that would once again change the structure of the Star Field.

Back then, many organizations had tried to break the relationship between the Black Star Corps and Floating Dragon, but they had failed and could only accept the truth. Now, many organizations were still unwilling to see the relationship between Floating Dragon and the Black Star Corps become closer.

This involved their own interests, and many organizations were alarmed.

…

Ignoring the thoughts of the large organizations in the Shattered Star Ring, many financial groups were excited.

Blue Star's development prospects were not bad to begin with, and now that they had Floating Dragon, their potential had increased exponentially.

The financial groups that had already cooperated with Floating Dragon decided to invest a large sum of money, and even more financial groups saw the business opportunity brought by Floating Dragon and sent people to Blue Star to seek cooperation.

The people of Blue Star naturally did not have any objections and were pleasantly surprised.

…

Flickering World, Garu Star Cluster …

Streams of hyperdrive streaked across the universe and stopped outside the atmosphere of a purple-blue planet. This was the fleet Han Xiao was in.

Although it was the main fleet, most of them had already been spread out to explore other unknown planets. Thus, the size of the fleet was not large.

This purple-blue planet was the trading hub of this Star Zone in Han Xiao's memories, and it was the target that he was planning to explore personally. In his previous life, it was called Planet Pangurus.

Because there were no stargates in this unexplored region, the fleet flew for a period of time before arriving.

"We have arrived at the designated location. Army Commander, please give the next order."

Aurora stood up straight and pretended to be serious as she reported to Han Xiao like a soldier. However, just as she finished speaking, she could not hold it in and started laughing. She only stopped laughing after being glared at by Hella.

"Engineering team, throw a stargate here first. Scout spaceships, circle this planet in the air and map the terrain. Use detection equipment to detect life signals and underground resources. After the map is completed, send out a ground exploration team to conduct a thorough global search. Then …"

Before Han Xiao could finish, Philip suddenly appeared in his mind and interrupted him.

"Master, Master, there is an urgent message from Blue Star, hum!"

The message was sent by Bennett in the quantum network, saying that they had successfully received Floating Dragon. He also mentioned the matter of the Avitan Souls and attached the recording of the spaceship. In the recording, there was evidence of a group of Avitan Souls plotting to attack Blue Star.

Han Xiao raised his brows.

"Sisko didn't provoke me, but there are people in his race who want to deal with me … Avitan Souls? There seems to be such a small organization. Don't they hate EsGod? They even took their anger out on me. Er, I don't think it's considered taking their anger out on me … They want to blow up the entire planet with a suicide attack. Is there a need to have such a deep hatred? What a tiger. Also, where did their advanced psionic bombs come from … "

Han Xiao was a little helpless. This was one of the side effects of occupying the Evolution Cube. He was already used to such extremists. Everyone's psychological endurance was different. Disasters and wars had always been the best way to catalyze extremist organizations. Logic was never the only way an intelligent creature judged things. Motives that came from emotions were stronger than logic, and hatred was one of the strongest motives. As long as it was not a race without desires, there would always be people who would be influenced by them.

However, the revenge of this group of extremists was more of a hindrance to Psyker than a help.

Han Xiao shook his head. He did not intend to let things go and pretend that nothing had happened.

Since Blue Star had a seat in the Civilization Conference, it was equivalent to receiving the treatment of a Star System civilization and being protected by the Peace Treaty. Sisko's race had given him an opportunity to make things difficult for him.

He replied with a message, which contained instructions to Bennett.

"Keep the evidence and contact the Amethyst Civilization in my name. Bring this matter to the Shattered Star Ring Civilization Conference and expose this to all civilizations. Leave the rest to me."

Although this did not happen and could not do anything to Sisko, it was still possible to annoy him.

A small group of his race had personally delivered the evidence to him, and in the end, the entire Star Pupil Race had to take the blame. Would Sisko feel tired?
